title: Reflection on GenAI
text:
In this assessment, I utilized Generative AI tools to assist me not just with understanding the instructions, but also with the technical implementation of the website using Quarto and RStudio.


I specifically used AI to help me debug technical errors, such as: 1. Troubleshooting R Code: When my data visualization graph failed to render due to missing packages (ggplot2), the AI helped me identify the error and provided the correct installation commands. 2. Formatting & Layout: I used AI to generate the code for the 2-column layout on my Hobbies page, allowing me to present my images side-by-side cleanly.



I chose to use this tool because it acts like a “24/7 Tutor.” It didn’t just give me the answers; it explained why my code was breaking (e.g., missing library dependencies). This helped me learn the logic behind Quarto rather than just copying blindly.
Overall, GenAI significantly improved my efficiency. However, I learned that human oversight is still crucial—I still had to verify the output, choose the right images, and personalize the content to match my own story.

title: Final Year Project (Temasek Poly)
text:
Diploma in Accountancy & Finance
For my final year project at Temasek Polytechnic, I conducted a comprehensive financial analysis of a publicly listed company in the retail sector. The goal was to assess the company’s financial health, liquidity, and profitability over a 5-year period.








NoteThen: Manual Process



Back in Poly, my toolkit was limited to traditional methods:

Microsoft Excel: Heavily relied on VLOOKUPs and Pivot Tables.
MYOB: Used standard legacy accounting software.
Method: Time-consuming manual data entry and reconciliation.









TipNow: The Fintech Shift



At SIT, I am learning to automate these exact tasks:

Python & R: Writing scripts to process data instantly.
Automation: Replacing manual entry with code.
Real-time Analysis: Moving from static reports to dynamic dashboards.






This project taught me the fundamentals of reading financial statements, but it also highlighted the inefficiencies of manual accounting. This frustration is exactly what led me to pursue Fintech—to solve these problems with code.

title: Data Visualization
text:
The visualization below shows a breakdown of personal monthly spending across different budget categories.



This chart visualizes how personal monthly expenses are allocated across categories such as housing, food, transportation, savings, entertainment, and miscellaneous spending.



From the chart, housing takes up the largest portion of the budget at 30%. Food and savings each account for 20%, while transportation makes up 15%. Entertainment and miscellaneous expenses represent smaller portions of the overall spending.



A pie (donut) chart was used because it effectively shows how each category contributes to the total budget, making it easy to compare proportions at a glance.

title: Final Year Project
text:
Before entering SIT, I studied Accountancy and Finance at Temasek Polytechnic. As part of my learning experience, I worked on a project related to personal finance tracking and budget analysis.
The project focused on recording daily expenses, categorising spending such as food, transport, and entertainment, and analysing spending patterns over time. The goal was to improve financial awareness and support better budgeting decisions.
Through this project, I gained a better understanding of how financial data can be organised and analysed to support decision-making. This experience also helped prepare me for learning new digital and analytical tools at SIT.

The project focused on recording daily expenses, categorising spending such as food, transport, and entertainment, and analysing spending patterns over time. The goal was to improve financial awareness and support better budgeting decisions.

title: Data Visualization
text:
During my time at Temasek Polytechnic, I noticed that preparing financial statements often involved hours of manual data entry. Now, as a Fintech student, I have learned how automation can drastically reduce this time.
This graph visualizes a simulation I conducted to compare the time taken to process 1,000 financial records manually versus using a Python/R script.












What is visualized? I visualized the quantitative difference in time efficiency (measured in minutes) between traditional manual methods and modern automated methods.
Why this visualization? I chose a Bar Chart because the dramatic difference in height between the two bars (300 mins vs 5 mins) effectively highlights the magnitude of efficiency gained through Fintech. This visual evidence supports my decision to transition from accountancy to a tech-focused career.
